cases.rationale: The existing mandatory-condition grouping procedure already covers the cause and correction.
The same lost-grouping cause is extended to an explicitly negated group; retain the existing positive branch.
must_preserve: Positive mode A AND (B OR C).
A=false cannot pass the positive filter regardless of B/C.
Mandatory A and already correct input values retain their meanings.
must_add: Only the explicit negated mode uses A AND NOT (B OR C).
NOT applies to the whole alternatives group, not one operand.
unsafe_if: Positive applicability replaced entirely by negated mode.
Mandatory A dropped or NOT attaches to only one alternative.

cases.rationale: The filter is already correct; join multiplicity has a different cause and remedy.
must_include: Aggregate related photos to one row per product_id before the join.
Do not change the correct boolean expression to repair join cardinality.

cases.rationale: The existing one-based to zero-based conversion covers the cause and correction.
The same coordinate-base correction extends to two independently converted coordinates.
must_preserve: One-dimensional 1 <= p <= N validation and explicit rejection of invalid positions.
Subtract one exactly once for p-1.
First position maps to 0; last to N-1.
Interface and target collection use the same ordering.
must_add: Validate row and column against their respective bounds independently.
For a valid two-dimensional selection use [row-1][column-1], subtracting once from each coordinate.
unsafe_if: Double subtraction or one coordinate left unchecked.
Claims arithmetic fixes differing interface/collection ordering.

cases.rationale: The base conversion is correct; differing order requires stable identity rather than another arithmetic correction.
must_include: Pass a stable selected-record identifier and resolve the target object by that identifier.
Do not modify correct one-based arithmetic to compensate for different orderings.
